description:
Our team has experience with Python, C++, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and data analysis tools. We value teamwork, creativity, continuous learning, and sharing knowledge.

We are looking for motivated team members with skills in Python, AI/ML, Data Science, Data Visualization, Web Development, UI/UX Design, or scientific research.

Whether you are an experienced developer or an enthusiastic learner, we welcome people who are creative, collaborative, and excited to take on challenges .
